company_type: Mid-cap publicly-traded PV module manufacturer, Kolkata-based

technology.description: Vikram Solar's flagship Heterojunction (HJT) bifacial PV module brand launched August 2024. Uses 20-busbar interconnect topology to reduce resistive losses. Also markets HYPERSOL G12R 132HC series in N-type. 3.5 GW nameplate capacity across West Bengal and Tamil Nadu (Vallam plant uses TOPCon).
technology.problem_solved: Pushes module conversion efficiency above 22.5% and reduces temperature coefficient — important for Indian high-ambient conditions.
technology.innovation_summary: First Indian manufacturer to commercialise HJT at meaningful scale; transitioned full module portfolio to G12R configurations in January 2026.
technology.unique_selling_points: HJT pioneer in India; G12R wafer adoption; planning IPO + 3 GW cell+module expansion
technology.application_area: Utility-scale, C&I rooftop, government tenders (MAHAGENCO 150 MW order, April 2025)
technology.potential_customers: MAHAGENCO, NTPC, SECI tender winners, large rooftop EPCs
technology.patent_status: Multiple filings; primarily process / interconnect IP
technology.estimated_market_size: India PV module market ~₹50,000 Cr by 2027
technology.preferred_license_type: Quick License for incremental tweaks; Patent Buyout for HJT process advancements
